deadline_text_verbatim: Note that the deadline is 1 March for all applicants with a Norwegian or Nordic Citizenship and an education background from a country outside the Nordics.
limitations: No year. Also note this rule is keyed to citizenship AND prior-education country jointly, so it cannot be derived from either alone.
researcher_notes: A Nordic citizen educated outside the Nordics gets the EU/EEA date, not the Nordic one. Two-dimensional eligibility: the naive single-key lookup gives the wrong answer for exactly the internationally-mobile students ORYN serves.

requirement_text: International students with citizenship from outside the EU/EEA or Switzerland will be charged tuition fees. This also applies if you already live in Norway and have a valid redience permit. ... NTNU does not offer any scholarships that cover tuition fees.
limitations: Quoted verbatim including the source's typo 'redience' for 'residence'. Not corrected, because text_fidelity: verbatim_quoted means what it says.
researcher_notes: Second confirmation from a Norwegian institution that the tuition-free-for-all premise is out of date. Note residence in Norway does not by itself exempt -- only the listed permit categories do.

university_name: Norwegian University of Science And Technology
requirement_text: Students belonging to one of these categories are exempted from the requirement to pay tuition fees - and do not have to apply for an exemption: Citizens of an EU/EEA country or Switzerland. Exchange students from NTNU's partner universities. Students who were admitted to their study program before 2023. ... Students admitted to an Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters programme and Joint Nordic Master's degree programme (Nordic Five Tech). ... Doctoral students/PhD students.
limitations: Bulleted list flattened into one string; clauses are the source's words, the connective framing is not. Re-read before splitting into separate rules.
researcher_notes: 'Students who were admitted to their study program before 2023' is a grandfather clause that dates the policy precisely: Norway's fees began with the autumn 2023 intake. Also note the two-tier structure -- these exemptions are automatic, while a second set (permanent residency, protection status) requires an application with documentation.
